cloud_model.description: Cloud model for heavy tasks (PREFER_IN_CLOUD / ONLY_IN_CLOUD).

fallback_cloud_model.description: Cloud model the SDK falls back to for light tasks (PREFER_ON_DEVICE) and consented cloud-assisted detection.

on_device_token_budget.description: Largest prompt, in estimated tokens, routed to the on-device model. Gemini Nano's hard limit is 9216 including output.

detect_chunk_chars.description: Chunk size, in characters, for entity detection.

allow_cloud_detection.description: Whether users on devices without a local model may opt in to cloud-assisted name detection.

max_document_chars.description: Maximum document length accepted by the app.
